patches.summary: Set c.NoCache = true in the watch command after newClient(), so the 15-30s poll loop bypasses the 5-min HTTP response cache.
patches.reason: Without this, every poll after the first read returned the cached snapshot and live score changes were invisible until cache expiry. The sync command already uses this pattern; the watch command needs it too. Flagged by Greptile as a P1 functional defect.

patches.summary: Quote+escape resourceType in store.ListIDs and allowlist field tokens in store.ResolveByName to block SQL injection through user-influenced resource/field names.
patches.reason: Both methods interpolated caller-supplied strings directly into SQL via fmt.Sprintf. Greptile flagged as P1 security. This is a generator-template issue affecting other library CLIs as well — should also be fixed upstream in cli-printing-press templates. Patching here so this PR can land cleanly while the upstream fix propagates.
deferred_to_upstream: Fix the same pattern in the generator template so future CLIs ship without the injection vector.

patches.summary: Use exact equality in today.go's formatMatches helper. Was strings.Contains, which silently included T20I matches when user passed --format t20.
patches.reason: Substring matching meant any format that's a prefix/substring of another would match unintended formats. Greptile P1. CricAPI's matchType tokens are short (t20, odi, test, t10, hundred); exact case-insensitive comparison is the correct semantics. Also updated the --format flag help text to drop the misleading 't20i' suggestion since CricAPI returns 't20' for T20I matches.
